scene.title: Binary Search for 23
scene.summary: Binary search repeatedly halves the search space by comparing the target with the middle element until 23 is found at index 5.

beats.title: Search setup
beats.narration: We want to locate 23 inside a sorted array of 10 elements using binary search.

beats.title: First midpoint: index 4
beats.narration: With range 0 to 9, the midpoint is index 4 (16). Since 16 is less than 23, the target must lie to the right.

beats.title: Second midpoint: index 7
beats.narration: The new range is 5 to 9. Midpoint index 7 contains 56, which is greater than 23, ruling out the right side.

beats.title: Target found at index 5
beats.narration: The range narrows to indices 5 to 6. Midpoint index 5 contains 23 — target found in just 3 steps!
